{
  "rationale": "Evidence. Scores by iteration: 89.0 (it0), 124.4 (it1, best), 48.9 (it2), 96.0 (it3). No run finished, and every track ends with off_track. The max_error values sit at the 0.06 m off-track limit. Iteration 1 had the best progress (0.50 on the oval) but high steering_oscillation (0.28 oval, 0.26 s-bend) and 1.1 to 1.35 line-loss events per run. Iteration 2 (kp 2.0, wide 16 mm sensors) was too sluggish, with progress near 0.12. Iteration 3 (kp 3.5, kd 0.4, 0.12 m track, 12 mm spacing) scored lower than iteration 1 (96 vs 124), so raising kp alone did not help. Two causes look likely. First, the fixed left/right motor mismatch in the disturbance creates a steady turn bias. With ki = 0 that bias becomes a steady lateral offset (about bias/kp), which can push the robot toward the 0.06 m limit on curves. Second, base_speed 1.4 is too fast for the bends, so the robot cannot recover before the error grows.\n\nChanges from iteration 1, which is the best design so far. (1) base_speed 1.4 to 1.2, to give the controller more time to correct on the bends. (2) kd 0.5 to 0.35, to reduce derivative amplification of sensor noise and the oscillation seen at kd 0.5. (3) ki 0 to 0.3, so the integral cancels the fixed motor-mismatch bias. The integral is capped at +/-2, so its turn contribution is at most 0.6, which limits windup on curves. Geometry is kept from iteration 1 (7 sensors at 10 mm spacing, x = -0.03 to +0.03, 12 mm footprint, 0.10 m track, 0.6 kg), because that array gave the best line retention and the highest turn authority. kp stays at 3.0.\n\nExpected result: steering_oscillation below about 0.2, max_error below 0.06 m, line_loss_events at 1 or fewer, and progress above 0.5 on the s-bend and slalom, with a chance of completing the oval. Hypotheses: (a) the integral term removes the steady offset from the motor mismatch and cuts max_error; (b) the lower speed and lower kd reduce oscillation and line loss on bends. Failure signs: if oscillation stays above 0.25, kd or kp is still too high; if progress stalls near 0.3 with few line losses, speed or kp is too low. Measurements to check next: max_error and line_loss_events for offset from the centre line, steering_oscillation for jitter, and completion_time for speed margin.",
